game.durak.name: Durak
game.durak.desc: The classic attack-and-defend card game: beat every card aimed at you or pick the table up, and make sure somebody else is left holding cards at the end.
game.durak.rule.1: The attacker plays cards and the defender beats each one with a higher card of the same suit or a trump.
game.durak.rule.2: The defender may take all cards instead. The last player holding cards is the durak.
game.durak.option.hand_size_hint: How many cards each player is dealt and draws back up to after every round.
game.durak.status_attack: {player} attacks: add a card of a rank already on the table, or finish the attack.
game.durak.status_defense: {defender} must beat the attack of {attacker} or take the cards.
game.durak.table_empty: No cards on the table yet.
game.durak.hint: Click a card to attack or to beat the attack. A card is beaten by a higher card of the same suit or by a trump.
game.durak.log_start: {player} opens the game; the trump card is {card}.
game.durak.log_fool: {player} is left holding cards and is the fool.
game.durak.reason.fool: The fool is left holding cards.
game.durak.reason.draw: Draw: the last cards left play together.
game.durak.reason.stalemate: Draw: with the deck empty both players keep picking the cards up.
game.durak.error.unknown_action: That action does not belong to durak.
game.durak.error.illegal_action: That card cannot be played now.
